notes.subject: meri bilong narapela man
notes.rationale: אשה זרה i tok long meri i no belong narapela lain o i no meri bilong man — 'strange woman' i tok long adultery long Mishlai

notes.subject: זרה/נכרי
notes.rationale: Tupela tok wantaim wankain mining (narapela) i stap namel namel long ves — rhetorik i kamap strong

translation: Bilong lukautim yu long meri bilong narapela man, na long meri bilong ol narapela lain — ol tok bilong em i smul tru.

tokens.gloss: long meri bilong ol narapela lain
